result:
Only formatting (Prettier-style line wrapping) was applied by the hook; logic is unchanged from what I wrote.

**Changed file:** `src/lib/auth/supabase-auth-transport.ts` (new file, 234 lines — slightly over the ~200-line target due to formatter re-wrapping, no logic added beyond the spec).

**Summary of implementation:**
- `AuthTransportError` — static `code`/`message` both `'auth_dependency_unavailable'`, no `cause`, thrown via a single `fail()` helper for every invalid-config/input/shape/network/parse case.
- `createSupabaseAuthTransport({ origin, publishableKey, fetch })` validates origin (HTTPS, exact `new URL(origin).origin` match — this single equality also rejects credentials/path/query/trailing slash) and publishable key (`sb_publishable_...` regex, which structurally excludes legacy/service keys) once at creation time.
- `login`/`refresh` both funnel through a shared `exchangeToken` hitting `POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=...`; success only on `200` via `authSuccessSchema` (zod strips unknown/profile fields, keeping only the 4 camelCase-mapped fields); provider denial → `null` only for the exact status/code pairs specified (`400`+`invalid_credentials` for login; `400`+`refresh_token_not_found`/`refresh_token_already_used` for refresh); anything else best-effort cancels the body and throws.
- `user` → `GET /auth/v1/user`, success only `200` (`{id}` only), `null` only on `401`+`bad_jwt`/`session_not_found`.
- `logout` → `POST /auth/v1/logout?scope=local`, no body, success only on `204`, otherwise cancel+fail. No claim of immediate revocation (documented in the class comment).
- All requests use `cache:'no-store'`, `redirect:'error'`, exact caller `signal`, `apikey`/`Accept: application/json` headers (+`Content-Type: application/json` on token POST); `signal.aborted` checked before fetch and after fetch/read, no retries anywhere.
- Body reads go through the existing `readBoundedJson` with the exact structural `{headers, body, bodyUsed}` object (only `content-type` forwarded, `content-length`/`content-encoding` omitted so wire length isn't misapplied to Fetch-decoded bytes), bounded at 65536 bytes.
- Credential/token inputs validated with zod (`email` ≤254, `password` 1–1024) and the visible-ASCII `/^[\x21-\x7E]{1,16384}$/` pattern for `refreshToken`/`accessToken` before use in `Authorization` headers.

**Limitations / left to root:** I did not modify `request-policy.ts` (its `Pick<Request,'headers'|'body'|'bodyUsed'>` type already structurally accepts the literal object passed here, so no widening was strictly required by my code, but root owns any intentional type-widening/rename there). No tests were added — root owns test authoring. Not wired into `SessionAuthority` or any caller. I have not run `pnpm verify`/typecheck; please run independently. Real hosted-provider response shapes (exact `content-type`, whether Supabase ever adds unexpected extra top-level fields) are per the plan's cited docs/pinned `auth-js` source only, not live-verified.
